messages:
marisa_peopleops: Heads-up — Oliver (new hire) starts Mon 9:00am PT / 18:00 CET. Opening a logistics thread for Day 1: I-9, badge pickup, laptop, benefits timing. Who's owning what?

nina_recruiter: Oliver is fine with a hybrid Day 1 (remote morning, onsite badge Tue). He said passport renewal is in progress; current passport expired last month.

oliver_newhire: Thanks everyone! Question: my SSN card is at my parents' place and passport is renewing. Can we do an alternate I-9 flow so I can still hit Day 1 tasks? Also, can benefits session be recorded — CET evening is better for me.

marisa_peopleops: Yes — options: mobile notary + secure upload, or remote verification with in-person follow-up within 3 business days. If follow-up impossible, we escalate to compliance for a time-limited exception. Benefits session will be recorded; I'll schedule a 1:1 for a CET-friendly time.

marisa_peopleops: ```I-9 summary for Oliver:
- Preferred: unexpired passport OR DL + SSN card in person.
- If passport expired / SSN not present: mobile notary (notarized copy) uploaded to secure portal + in-person verification within 3 business days.
- If both not possible within 3 days -> HR compliance review for exception and temporary access.
- Upload link: https://redwood-secure/hr-upload (use "New Hire Docs" folder, tag with your name)
```

tony_itops: I'll take badge & kiosk reservation. Tentative slot Tue 10:30am SF kiosk. Will also arrange laptop courier for Mon EOD to Oliver's address unless you want pickup onsite Tue.

sophie-mentor: I'll meet Oliver at 10:15 for escort & quick desk walkthrough. Can grab a spare keyboard/mouse if needed.

nina_recruiter: Background check: consent received, vendor kicked off. ETA typically 48-72 hours; I'll ping if any flags.

oliver_newhire: For the notarized docs, do I need local notary or is a mobile notary OK? And if I upload, will that be encrypted end-to-end?

marisa_peopleops: Mobile notary is fine. Portal uses encrypted upload (our compliance team confirmed). After upload, tag me and I'll confirm receipt. Remember the 3 business day in-person follow-up window.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Badge pickup / escort — Oliver" Tue 10:30am PT. Guests: oliver_newhire, sophie-mentor, tony_itops.

marisa_peopleops: Action items (please reply with :thumbsup: when confirmed):
- Badge & kiosk slot: @tony_itops
- Mentor escort & desk setup: @sophie-mentor
- Laptop shipping: @tony_itops
- I-9 notary intake & doc link: @marisa_peopleops + oliver_newhire to upload
- Benefits recording & CET 1:1: @marisa_peopleops
- Background check follow-up: @nina_recruiter

marisa_peopleops: If anyone needs to swap ownership or has timing conflicts, flag here. Otherwise I'll assume these owners and close the loop EOD.
